sources.title: Introducing Stable Diffusion 3.5 - Stability AI
sources.snippet: Today we are introducing Stable Diffusion 3.5. This open release includes multiple model variants, including Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large and Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large Turbo, and as of October 29th, Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium.
